topics.name: Nvidia H20 Export Ban
topics.summary: The US government banned Nvidia from selling H20 chips to China indefinitely, triggering a $5.5B charge and ~10% stock decline. Nvidia had designed the H20 as a compliant workaround chip for the Chinese market, but the government determined it violated supercomputer end-use restrictions.

topics.name: China Semiconductor History (1978–2025)
topics.summary: Deep dive into China's semiconductor ambitions from Deng Xiaoping's 1978 reforms through the 863, 908, and 909 programs, SMIC's founding, Made in China 2025, the Big Fund, and current restrictions. China has been systematically investing in domestic chip production for over 40 years.

topics.name: US-China AI Chip Export Controls Debate
topics.summary: Ben Thompson and Dylan Patel have differing views: Thompson opposes broad chip controls but supports equipment controls, arguing the Huawei Cloud Matrix 384's TSMC dependency is a useful lever. Patel takes a more hawkish view, arguing the entire supply chain must be controlled.

topics.name: Huawei Cloud Matrix 384 vs Nvidia NVL72
topics.summary: Huawei's new AI system delivers 300 petaflops vs Nvidia's 180 petaflops NVL72, but is significantly more power-hungry and costly. Semi Analysis described it as impressive on raw compute but unattractive outside China due to power efficiency trade-offs.

topics.name: GPU Smuggling into China
topics.summary: An estimated 100,000+ controlled GPUs were smuggled into China in 2024, with individual cases involving over 20,000 GPUs at once. China has a long history of smuggling controlled goods, and the scale of GPU smuggling is growing significantly.

topics.name: Meta FTC Antitrust Trial
topics.summary: FTC is suing Meta over its Instagram and WhatsApp acquisitions, seeking $30B; Meta offered $450M. Trial kicked off with Zuckerberg on the witness stand. Ben Thompson argues the government's market definition is flawed and doesn't account for TikTok and algorithmic video competition.

topics.name: NEO Fund $320M Raise
topics.summary: Ali Partovi's NEO announced a $320M fund raise, its fourth fund. NEO positions itself primarily as a mentorship community that identifies top technical college talent and has backed companies like Cursor, Kalshi, and Blue Sky from very early stages.

topics.name: OpenAI Acquires Windsurf
topics.summary: OpenAI is in talks to acquire coding app Windsurf (formerly Codium) for ~$3B, which would be its largest acquisition ever. Green Oaks backed the company from seed and stands to make a significant return.

topics.name: AI Inference vs Training
topics.summary: Inference compute is becoming as or more strategically important than training compute, a shift that made H20 chips more valuable than initially anticipated. Analysts forecast inference compute demand could outstrip training by 4x by 2026.

topics.name: ISO Power and Energy Efficiency in AI
topics.summary: Jensen Wong has emphasized ISO power—maximizing compute within a fixed power envelope—as the key metric for next-gen AI chips. This contrasts with Huawei's approach of sacrificing efficiency for raw compute, an approach only viable where energy is cheap.

topics.name: Blue Origin Space Tourism Mission
topics.summary: Blue Origin conducted a high-profile mission with Katy Perry, Gail King, and Lauren Sanchez, generating massive mainstream media coverage. Discussed as a marketing exercise for Blue Origin rather than technical space achievement.

topics.name: Figma S1 Filing
topics.summary: Figma filed its S1, marking a major milestone after years in stealth and a failed Adobe acquisition attempt. Hosts noted it as an overnight success story many years in the making.

topics.name: Internet Outage During Show
topics.summary: Zoom, Google Meet, Spotify, and Apple all experienced downtime during the show, preventing scheduled guest interviews. Hosts speculated about a possible cyber attack.

topics.name: Foundation Model VC Conflicts
topics.summary: Several major VC firms are invested in multiple competing foundation model companies. Kyle Harrison published a chart showing this; Thrive Capital's Josh Kushner was praised for only backing OpenAI.

topics.name: US Government Technology Policy Agenda
topics.summary: Michael Kratzios posted about the Trump administration's technology policy agenda focused on removing regulatory barriers to innovation and rebuilding American industrial capacity.
